verdict.rationale: Brave Search API supports domain exclusion/restriction via query operators like 'site:' and '-' minus exclusion, plus Goggles for custom boosting/demoting of specific websites and domains, giving developers multiple mechanisms to control which domains appear. missing for 10: no dedicated first-class 'exclude_domains' API parameter is documented (relies on query syntax and Goggles), and no independent/hands-on verification confirming reliability of these exclusion mechanisms in practice.
